title: Reconnaissance hydrogeologic investigation of the Defense Waste Processing Facility and vicinity, Savannah River Plant, South Carolina
citation: Dennehy, K.F., Prowell, D.C., and McMahon, P.B., 1989, Reconnaissance hydrogeologic investigation of the Defense Waste Processing Facility and vicinity, Savannah River Plant, South Carolina: U.S. Geological Survey Water-Resources Investigations Report 88-4221, map scale 1:55,500.
notes: Table 1 correlation chart (p. 15) is garbled OCR and was skipped; table 2 hydraulic conductivities (p. 39) are partly garbled, so conductivities are taken from the text. Geologic and hydrogeologic sections and maps (figs. 5-20) give only labels. Table 3 (p. 42): OCR reads 'A' for '4' in well numbers and values; corrected values are noted per well; SDS-4A has a single water level whose column is unclear and was skipped. Thickness of the green clay differs: 2 to 6 ft (pp. 6, 23) versus averaging about 10 ft (p. 40); tan clay 2 to 10 ft (p. 25) versus 0 to 10 ft (pp. 6, 36). Abstract conductivity exponents are garbled and skipped. Continues in packet-02. No image-only pages.
